notices.html: Book ahead for Bellemont Farm's Sunflower Festival: advance online tickets ($19 adult, $12 kids) are cheaper than at the door ($25, $15), and the festival runs weekends through September 13 if this one's booked up.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: blackberries and cut-your-own flowers are pick-your-own, but there's still no peach crop this year after the spring freeze. Store and market are open daily; call 609-924-2310 to confirm what's ripe before you drive over.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed 2026 update posted online for this small, family-run farm, but August typically brings peaches, tomatoes, cantaloupe and the season's first apples. Call 609-448-0629 to confirm the day's picking and hours before you go.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: blackberries are pick-your-own at the Monmouth Junction fields ($3 field admission plus a container fee), and apples aren't ripe yet. The Sunflower Trail is only at Von Thun's Washington Township farm, not here; Monmouth Junction's fall festival with corn maze and pumpkins starts September 19. Call 732-329-8656 to confirm what's ready to pick.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: Emery's blueberry season has wrapped for the year. Sunflowers grow here but are sold bunched at the farm market rather than pick-your-own. Call 609-758-8514 to check what's out before you drive over.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: the spring freeze wiped out cherries, peaches, nectarines and apples this year, so pick-your-own fruit stays limited at Battleview. The bakery and farm store are still open for cider donuts and baked goods; call 732-462-0756 to confirm what's on hand.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: the Sunflower Celebration (hayride to the fields, pick your own blossoms) is running now alongside late-summer peaches, tomatoes and zucchini. Picking dates can shift by a week or more, so call the Pick Your Own Hotline 609-654-5894 before you drive over.
